title: A Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy Study of VX-880 and VX-017 in Participants With Type 1 Diabetes
official: A Master Protocol to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of Islet Cell Replacement Therapies in Subjects Who Have Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus With Impaired Hypoglycemic Awareness and Severe Hypoglycemia: A Phase 1/2/3 Study of VX-880 and a Phase 1/2 Study of VX-017
summary: This study will evaluate the safety, tolerability and efficacy of VX-880 infusion and VX-017 infusion in participants with type 1 diabetes (T1D) and impaired awareness of hypoglycemia (IAH) and severe hypoglycemia.
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical history of T1D with \>=5 years of duration of insulin dependence
* At least two episodes of documented severe hypoglycemia in the 12 months prior to enrollment
* Stable diabetic treatment
* Consistent use of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) for at least 3 months before Screening and willingness to use CGM for the duration of the study

Key Exclusion Criteria:

-Prior islet cell transplant, organ transplant, or cell therapy

Other protocol-defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria may apply
